Class ApiSettings

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.api.internal.ApiSettings
public final class ApiSettings extends Object
Validated, per-request access to the SHAFT API property family: the response-status flag, the three API timeouts, Swagger validation and OpenAPI coverage (#6326).

Every value is read when a request is performed, on the calling thread, so SHAFT.Properties.*.set() calls made after new SHAFT.API(...) apply, and a per-thread timeout override never leaks into another thread's requests. Booleans accept true/false in any case; numbers accept surrounding whitespace. Anything else fails with the property key, the rejected value and a Fix: line.
